children: USA Compression Partners priced a $600.0 million private placement of 6.750% senior notes due 2035, expected to yield net proceeds of approximately $592.1 million.
Issued $600.0M of 6.750% senior unsecured notes due 2035 in a private placement to eligible purchasers.
Notes are jointly and severally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by existing and future restricted subsidiaries.
Estimated net proceeds of ~$592.1M to be used to repay borrowings under the Partnership’s credit agreement and pay offering fees.
Sale to initial purchasers at par; offering expected to close on or about September 18, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
Notes sold under Section 4(2) exemption; resales limited to Rule 144A qualified institutional buyers and Regulation S non-U.S. persons.
